title: Actively exploited sandbox RCE in all Chromium versions
summary: This content discusses a critical actively exploited sandbox remote code execution vulnerability (CVE-2026-85046) affecting all Chromium versions. It highlights a security flaw in the browser's sandboxing mechanism, posing severe risk to users and applications relying on Chromium. The discussion on Hacker News focuses on technical details, impact, and mitigation strategies.
